results.name: Intel Corp.
results.description: Intel Corp. designs, manufactures, and sells integrated digital technology platforms worldwide. The company was incorporated on July 18, 1968.

results.name: Intco Medical Technology Co. Ltd.
results.description: Intco Medical Technology Co. Ltd. formerly Shandong Intco Medical Products Co. Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and marketing of medical disposable products and durable medical equipment. The company was founded on July 20, 2009.

results.name: INTC Inc.
results.description: Intc Inc is a company that operates in the Custom Software & IT Services industry. It employs 10to19 people and has 1Mto5M of revenue. The company is based in Laguna Niguel, CA.

results.name: Intco Recycling Resources Co. Ltd.
results.description: Intco Recycling Resources Co. Ltd. (formerly Shandong Intco Recycling Resources Co. Ltd.) produces and sells general purpose polystyrene decorative skirting, environmental protection frame line, and other products. The company also provides recycled plastic recycling services. It was established in 2002 as Shanghai Inco Industrial Co. Ltd.

results.name: INTC Communications
results.description: INTC Communications, a subsidiary of XChange Communications LLC, is a company headquartered in the United States. The firm provides VoIP services. On 20 Jun 07 XChange Communications LLC acquired INTC Communications. Provides VoIP services.
